snippet.title: Mini Motorways Creative Mode - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Creative Mode coming to Mini Motorways - a puzzle strategy game released by New Zealand studio Dinosaur Polo Club as a follow-up to the 2015 video game Mini Metro. The new mode will be released via an update on August 26th. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #minimotorways #creativemode
